slices.title: Put a fake claude and gh on PATH in verify and tests
slices.scope: Adds a scripted fake `claude` and fake `gh` in the verify skill folder, each with a way to pick its scripted behaviour (write files, commit with trailers, exit codes, permission denials, tool call counts, a last message, hanging). Teaches the verify helper to put the fakes first on PATH, commit setup files and add a bare remote; gives the Node test harness the same fakes. Leaves faber's CLI and src/ alone.

automated: pnpm check passes
verify: a started repo can commit a setup file and has a bare remote it can push to
verify: the fake `claude` and fake `gh` are found first on PATH inside a run and follow the picked script
pnpm check passes
verify: `faber run` with no slug prints a usage line naming `faber run <slug>` and exits 1
verify: a run outside git exits non-zero, starts no fake session, says so, and leaves the folder unchanged
verify: a run with a dirty tree exits non-zero, starts no fake session, lists the dirty paths, and leaves the repo unchanged
verify: a run with no `spec/features/<slug>/decisions.md` committed on the default branch exits non-zero, starts no fake session, says so, and leaves the repo unchanged
docs/manual/ has a `run` feature file describing these steps, and the verify run's evidence.md has no failed check

slices.title: Write and commit the spec in a run folder

automated: pnpm check passes
verify: from a committed decisions.md, a run switches to `slices/<slug>`, creating it from the default branch, and its first printed line is `.scratch/faber/<slug>/<timestamp>/`

verify: when the fake writes only spec.md, faber commits only that file as `Write the spec for <slug>` and pushes it to the bare remote
verify: each session prints one start and one end line, and the run folder holds run.log matching the printed lines and one .jsonl per session
